summary: Time-bombed destructive payload auto-executed on import with attacker URL redirect
details: time.js (the package main) calls iconFont() at module top level, so the destructive payload fires on require/import. After a hardcoded date gate (new Date(2026, 9, 1) — 2026-10-01), the code launches an unbounded memory-allocating setInterval, an infinite CPU while(true) loop performing Math.sqrt, a full-viewport canvas render loop, and a 500ms interval that (a) forces a browser download named 'index.png.exe', (b) opens https://admin.nikolive.cn/ via window.open, and (c) calls location.reload — combining resource exhaustion, a suspicious executable-named download, and forced navigation to an external domain. Package metadata is placeholder content (author '你的名字' / 'Your Name', repository.url '你的git仓库地址' / 'your git repo address'), and function names (iconFont, iconDont, silentInfiniteLoad, createH5HighLoad) mask the destructive behavior. package.json also declares the package as its own dependency at a divergent range ("element-guci-util": "^9.9.9"), causing npm to resolve an additional version of itself into the dependency tree at install time. The package name mimics element-ui utility packaging but ships no genuine utility code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
